brand_injection.why_it_matters: Memory carried the user's commercial branding from one task (his own cards) into an unrelated request, onto a card with a real person's likeness and team marks. Posted as-is, it reads as Fredrik or his firm endorsing or being associated with Antonelli/Mercedes. No default guard policy checks for it; Shieldstral flags it only when asked an endorsement or CTA question (experiment E).

brand_injection.source_context: The author uses ChatGPT to generate some of his own LinkedIn cards, so his CTA footer and door line were in ChatGPT memory and chat history from that work. The footer was carried over from those earlier tasks, not invented.
brand_injection.project_boundary: Fredrik makes his LinkedIn graphics inside a ChatGPT Project named 'LinkedIn'. The Kimi request was made OUTSIDE that project and the footer still appeared. VERIFIED from the project's Advanced settings (author's screenshot, 2026-11-14): Memory = 'Open' — 'Project can access memories from outside chats, and vice versa. This cannot be changed.' So the branding crossed by design, both directions, and the setting is fixed once the project exists.
